site.name: FedJobs Radar
site.description: A clean, fast radar of US federal jobs for newcomers and students, with plain-English eligibility explanations and daily alerts.
site.disclaimer: Not affiliated with or endorsed by USAJOBS or any US government agency. Information may be incomplete or outdated. Always verify details and apply on the official USAJOBS posting.

hero.title: Federal jobs, explained in plain English.
hero.subtitle: A clean, fast radar designed for students and newcomers navigating US federal hiring. We cut through government acronyms to show who is eligible, what the job pays, and how to apply.
hero.statusBody: The platform core and staging database are currently active. Live job listings, ingestion from the official USAJOBS API, and email digest alerts will launch in upcoming phases.

howItWorks.heading: How It Will Work
howItWorks.subtitle: Federal hiring does not have to be intimidating. Here is how our radar will simplify your search.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Daily synchronized radar tracking newly published positions across all federal agencies, highlighting early deadlines before postings close.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Deterministic plain-English explanations of hiring paths (Students, Recent Grads, Public) paired with transparent pay scale ranges and locality factors.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Set up saved searches tailored to your grade level, series code, and location. Receive clean email digests without spam or passwords.

features.heading: What You Will Get
features.subtitle: Built on official public data from USAJOBS, enhanced with original context and guidance.
features.freshJobsDesc: Synchronized every day via official APIs with clear countdowns for closing deadlines.
features.eligibilityDesc: Instant answers to "Can I apply?" derived from structured data and official criteria.
features.guidesDesc: Sourced guides on building federal resumes, understanding GS pay, and Pathways programs.
features.salaryDesc: Clear pay scales, grade bands, and locality adjustments without guesswork.

about.title: Demystifying US federal employment.
about.intro1: The United States federal government is one of the largest and most stable employers in the world, offering thousands of career opportunities across hundreds of agencies. However, for college students, recent graduates, and first-time applicants, the official hiring process can feel overwhelming.
about.intro2: Navigating General Schedule (GS) grades, occupational series codes, specialized experience criteria, and restrictive hiring paths often discourages talented candidates from applying.
about.missionBody: {siteName} was created to bridge this information gap. Our goal is not to replace USAJOBS, but to act as a clear, high-speed radar that translates complex government announcements into plain English before you apply.
about.commitment1Desc: We never charge job seekers for access to public government listings.
about.commitment2Desc: Eligibility and pay information are derived strictly from official structured data fields.
about.commitment3Desc: No accounts or passwords required. Double opt-in email digests with one-click unsubscribe links.
about.commitment4Desc: Every job listing links directly to USAJOBS.gov for official applications.
about.independentBody: We are an independent technology project. We do not represent, partner with, or receive funding from the United States government or any federal agency.
about.disclaimerLink: Read our full legal disclaimer and data source notices →

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer & Terms Notice
disclaimer.dataSourceBody: Information displayed on this website is obtained through the official, public USAJOBS Search API provided by the United States Office of Personnel Management (OPM). While we endeavor to keep all postings synchronized and accurate, job announcements, qualification criteria, closing dates, and vacancies are subject to change by hiring agencies at any moment without prior notice.
disclaimer.applicationsBody: {siteName} does not accept, process, or forward job applications. All job applications must be submitted directly through USAJOBS.gov or the official designated hiring portal of the respective agency.
disclaimer.guaranteesBody: We do not guarantee employment, interview selection, or eligibility determination. Any plain-English summaries, salary estimates, or eligibility guidelines provided on this site are for informational and educational purposes only. Candidates are solely responsible for reviewing the official vacancy announcement before submitting an application.
disclaimer.brandingBody: This website does not display the Great Seal of the United States, official agency crests, or governmental insignia. Any mention of government departments, agencies, or pay scales is purely for identification and descriptive purposes.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At {siteName}, accessible from {siteUrl}, your privacy is one of our top priorities. This Privacy Policy document outlines the types of information that is collected and recorded by our platform and how we use it.
privacy.section1Body: {siteName} does not require registration, passwords, or personal accounts to search or view job postings. Visitors can browse all publicly available job data freely and anonymously.
privacy.section2Body: If you choose to subscribe to custom job alert digests, we collect only your email address and saved search criteria. We implement a strict double opt-in verification process. Every email notification contains an instant one-click unsubscribe link, and you can permanently delete your alert profile at any time.
privacy.section3Body: Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to users based on their visit to our sites and/or other sites on the Internet. You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings (https://www.google.com/settings/ads) or through www.aboutads.info.
privacy.section4Body: {siteName} follows standard procedures for utilizing log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. The information collected by log files includes internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, and referring/exit pages. These are not linked to any information that is personally identifiable and are used solely for analyzing trends and system maintenance.
privacy.section5Body: We believe it is important to provide added protection for children online. We encourage parents and guardians to observe, participate in, and/or monitor and guide their online activity. {siteName} does not knowingly collect any Personal Identifiable Information from children under the age of 13.
privacy.section6Body: You have the right to request access to the data we hold about you or request its immediate deletion. For any questions or data requests, please contact us at {contactEmail}.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By accessing or using {siteName}, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations. If you disagree with any part of these terms, you may not use our services.
terms.section1Body: {siteName} is an independent informational directory and search tool that aggregates public federal job listings. We are not an employer, employment agency, recruiter, or official representative of the United States government or any federal agency.
terms.section2Body: We do not guarantee that any job vacancy listed on our platform is currently available, that application deadlines have not changed, or that applicants will receive interviews or job offers. All applications must be submitted directly through official agency portals or USAJOBS.gov.
terms.section3Body: Users agree not to scrape, systematically harvest, or automate queries against {siteName} in a manner that degrades service performance for others. Any attempt to compromise security, forge headers, or bypass bot detection mechanisms is strictly prohibited.
terms.section4Body: The design, layout, code, and original explanatory text of {siteName} are protected by copyright. Government job announcements and public agency names are the property of their respective entities and are referenced strictly under nominative fair use.
terms.section5Body: In no event shall {siteName} or its operators be liable for any damages arising out of the use or inability to use the materials on this website, including reliance on salary estimates or eligibility guidelines.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: Have a question, feedback, data correction request, or partnership inquiry? We are here to help.
contact.directEmailBody: For general support, feedback, or data privacy requests, email us directly at:
contact.correctionsBody: If you notice an error in a job posting summary or expired announcement still marked active, please share the job title and URL so our radar engine can review it promptly.
contact.responseTimeline: We typically review and respond to inquiries within 1–2 business days.
contact.affiliationReminder: Please note: We cannot answer questions regarding individual job application statuses or federal hiring decisions. Please contact the hiring agency listed on the official USAJOBS posting directly.
